payload.text: ST0095 WP-14 (vc, 11:59Z, from cc; next after 0711; claim when starting): kind tags and a path's owner, each in one home. AC-14.1: one enum for the id families, with one wire spelling per surface (issue 0708), extending id.rs's IdKind. AC-14.2: one owner-of-a-path function for plan.rs, sync.rs, project.rs's classify and search, with no st_prefix key. One exchange of meaning with cc for each half. It lands before or after cc's WP-05+06 unit, never inside it; land it first if possible, since cc adds Form's hashed variant to id.rs in that unit.
